Three defects: (1) judge concurrency is controlled ONLY by an in-memory threading.Lock per MCP server instance (gitreins_mcp/server.py _eval_lock) — no cross-process/CLI serialization, and _submit_eval_job creates a new job per task.complete call with no check for an existing running job for the same task+workdir (no per-task single-flight in the shared disk job store); re-running task complete on a failing task multiplies judges.
